summary: A card for a Kresling collar that twists as it collapses, cut from one sheet and locked without glue.
license_note: MIT covers this card, and the grant clause is in examples/aurelia-card/LICENSE. NOTICE at https://mrdirno.github.io/vibe-cards/NOTICE.txt lists what the project cannot grant; nothing here enlarges or narrows it.
origin: Not a fork and not a repository of its own. This is a page-project inside mrdirno/vibe-cards, published on that repo's Pages surface, and its host repo's MIT is inherited by the code around the card rather than chosen for the design. The package arrived as a finished outside drop. Who authored the artwork is not recorded in this repository.
_note: L0, not L1. L0's clauses hold: this manifest is served at the url the card's chip carries, the page it names carries an account-free wishing well, and the repository has a LICENSE with a real SPDX id. L1 is not claimed on either of its added clauses. docs/EVALS.md is Card Studio's eval record, not this card's, so shipped changes here do not carry an eval meeting section 2. And nobody has built this object, so every dimension on the card is drawing arithmetic rather than a fit someone has measured. Section 3 says L0 when in doubt. Authorship is recorded at AUTHORSHIP.md beside this file: commissioned by the owner from Meta AI as a concept piece. The object it depicts is meant to be built by other people, and an idea needs no licence; the card's artwork is the owner's commission, and NOTICE governs what may be reused of it. This file states stable facts about this card only. An earlier version embedded byte counts, grep tallies and claims about what other files currently say; every one of those was falsified by the same commit that published them, including one that had claimed this very url was unreachable — a claim that would have been served inside the successful response to fetching it. A manifest that measures its own repository is false on arrival, so this one states no measurement at all.
